title.html:
Our measure of success?
That it feels distinctly yours.

body.html: A hotel room tells a different story from a reception area, a yacht or a gift. We begin with what makes yours distinctive. Function, material and design come together in accessories that carry your identity naturally.
SFP Hospitality is your personal point of contact for bespoke leather goods and accessories. From Berlin, we coordinate design, sampling and hand manufacture in the EU.
Fine genuine Italian leather and high-quality PU in many colours and finishes are key starting points; other materials are selected to suit the object.

How does a menu cover feel in the hand? What should a tray accommodate? How does a waste bin belong in a suite? These questions shape our work. We translate your requirements into dimensions, materials and details, developing an agreed specification as the basis for production.
A one-off commission receives the same personal attention as a coordinated guest-room collection. Very small runs are welcome, and we also have capacity for major projects.
An existing design, custom adaptation, fully bespoke development or coordinated collection can provide the route; your requirements determine the specification.

body.html: Material samples and artwork help establish colour, feel, internal details and logo placement. The scope and terms of sampling are agreed for your project.
